newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market light test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were $0.50 per cwt lower in a light test, compared with Thursday's close, USDA said.
Trade was moderate and demand light to moderate. Seller interest also was moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales. Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 67.00-67.50.
On a carcass basis (weight only), compared with Thursday's close. Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly 1.00 lower.

Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 1175-1275 lbs few 109.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250 lbs ld 105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1000-1200 lbs 108.00-109.00 few early 110.00.
